paragraphs.text: translated by
1. COME, be thou Mitra, Varuna, or Pusan, come, O Brhaspati, to mine oblation:
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पते प्रति मे देवतामिहि मित्रो वा यद्वरुणो वासि पूषा ।
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspate prati me devatāmihi mitro vā yadvaruṇo vāsi pūṣā |

paragraphs.text: With Maruts, Vasus, or Adityas, make thou Parjanya pour for Santanu his rain-drops.
paragraphs.original: आदित्यैर्वा यद्वसुभिर्मरुत्वान्स पर्जन्यं शंतनवे वृषाय
paragraphs.translit: ādityairvā yadvasubhirmarutvānsa parjanyaṃ śaṃtanave vṛṣāya

paragraphs.text: 2. The God, intelligent, the speedy envoy whom thou hast sent hath come to me, Devapi:
paragraphs.original: आ देवो दूतो अजिरश्चिकित्वान्त्वद्देवापे अभि मामगच्छत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā devo dūto ajiraścikitvāntvaddevāpe abhi māmagacchat |

paragraphs.text: Address thyself to me and turn thee hither within thy lips will I put brilliant language.
paragraphs.original: प्रतीचीनः प्रति मामा ववृत्स्व दधामि ते द्युमतीं वाचमासन्
paragraphs.translit: pratīcīnaḥ prati māmā vavṛtsva dadhāmi te dyumatīṃ vācamāsan

paragraphs.text: 3. Within my mouth, Brhaspati, deposit speech lucid, vigorous, and free from weakness,
paragraphs.original: अस्मे धेहि द्युमतीं वाचमासन्बृहस्पते अनमीवामिषिराम् ।
paragraphs.translit: asme dhehi dyumatīṃ vācamāsanbṛhaspate anamīvāmiṣirām |

paragraphs.text: Thereby to win for Santanu the rain-fall. The meath-rich drop from heaven hath passed within it.
paragraphs.original: यया वृष्टिं शंतनवे वनाव दिवो द्रप्सो मधुमाँ आ विवेश
paragraphs.translit: yayā vṛṣṭiṃ śaṃtanave vanāva divo drapso madhumām̐ ā viveśa

paragraphs.text: 4. Let the sweet drops descend on us, O Indra: give us enough to lade a thousand wagons.
paragraphs.original: आ नो द्रप्सा मधुमन्तो विशन्त्विन्द्र देह्यधिरथं सहस्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā no drapsā madhumanto viśantvindra dehyadhirathaṃ sahasram |

paragraphs.text: Sit to thy Hotar task; pay worship duly, and serve the Gods, Devapi, with oblation.
paragraphs.original: नि षीद होत्रमृतुथा यजस्व देवान्देवापे हविषा सपर्य
paragraphs.translit: ni ṣīda hotramṛtuthā yajasva devāndevāpe haviṣā saparya

paragraphs.text: 5. Knowing the God's good-will, Devapi, Rsi, the son of Rstisena, sate as Hotar.
paragraphs.original: आर्ष्टिषेणो होत्रमृषिर्निषीदन्देवापिर्देवसुमतिं चिकित्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: ārṣṭiṣeṇo hotramṛṣirniṣīdandevāpirdevasumatiṃ cikitvān |

paragraphs.text: He hath brought down from heaven's most lofty summit the ocean of the rain, celestial waters.
paragraphs.original: स उत्तरस्मादधरं समुद्रमपो दिव्या असृजद्वर्ष्या अभि
paragraphs.translit: sa uttarasmādadharaṃ samudramapo divyā asṛjadvarṣyā abhi

paragraphs.text: 6. Gathered together in that highest ocean, the waters stood by deities obstructed.
paragraphs.original: अस्मिन्समुद्रे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्नापो देवेभिर्निवृता अतिष्ठन् ।
paragraphs.translit: asminsamudre adhyuttarasminnāpo devebhirnivṛtā atiṣṭhan |

paragraphs.text: They hurried down set free by Arstisena, in gaping clefts, urged onward by Devapi.
paragraphs.original: ता अद्रवन्नार्ष्टिषेणेन सृष्टा देवापिना प्रेषिता मृक्षिणीषु
paragraphs.translit: tā adravannārṣṭiṣeṇena sṛṣṭā devāpinā preṣitā mṛkṣiṇīṣu

paragraphs.text: 7. When as chief priest for Santanu, Devapi, chosen for Hotar's duty, prayed beseeching,
paragraphs.original: यद्देवापिः शंतनवे पुरोहितो होत्राय वृतः कृपयन्नदीधेत् ।
paragraphs.translit: yaddevāpiḥ śaṃtanave purohito hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet |

paragraphs.text: Graciously pleased Brhaspati vouchsafed him a voice that reached the Gods and won the waters.
paragraphs.original: देवश्रुतं वृष्टिवनिं रराणो बृहस्पतिर्वाचमस्मा अयच्छत्
paragraphs.translit: devaśrutaṃ vṛṣṭivaniṃ rarāṇo bṛhaspatirvācamasmā ayacchat

paragraphs.text: 8. O Agni whom Devapi Arstisena, the mortal man, hath kindled in his glory,
paragraphs.original: यं त्वा देवापिः शुशुचानो अग्न आर्ष्टिषेणो मनुष्यः समीधे ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ tvā devāpiḥ śuśucāno agna ārṣṭiṣeṇo manuṣyaḥ samīdhe |

paragraphs.text: Joying in him with all the Gods together, urge on the sender of the rain, Parjanya.
paragraphs.original: विश्वेभिर्देवैरनुमद्यमानः प्र पर्जन्यमीरया वृष्टिमन्तम्
paragraphs.translit: viśvebhirdevairanumadyamānaḥ pra parjanyamīrayā vṛṣṭimantam

paragraphs.text: 9. All ancient Rsis with their songs approached thee, even thee, O Much-invoked, at sacrifices.
paragraphs.original: त्वां पूर्व ऋषयो गीर्भिरायन्त्वामध्वरेषु पुरुहूत विश्वे ।
paragraphs.translit: tvāṃ pūrva ṛṣayo gīrbhirāyantvāmadhvareṣu puruhūta viśve |

paragraphs.text: We have provided wagon-loads in thousands: come to the solemn rite, Lord of Red Horses.
paragraphs.original: सहस्राण्यधिरथान्यस्मे आ नो यज्ञं रोहिदश्वोप याहि
paragraphs.translit: sahasrāṇyadhirathānyasme ā no yajñaṃ rohidaśvopa yāhi

paragraphs.text: 10. The wagon-loads, the nine-and-ninety thousand, these have been offered up to thee, O Agni.
paragraphs.original: एतान्यग्ने नवतिर्नव त्वे आहुतान्यधिरथा सहस्रा ।
paragraphs.translit: etānyagne navatirnava tve āhutānyadhirathā sahasrā |

paragraphs.text: Hero, with these increase thy many bodies, and, stimulated, send us rain from heaven.
paragraphs.original: तेभिर्वर्धस्व तन्वः शूर पूर्वीर्दिवो नो वृष्टिमिषितो रिरीहि
paragraphs.translit: tebhirvardhasva tanvaḥ śūra pūrvīrdivo no vṛṣṭimiṣito rirīhi

paragraphs.text: 11. Give thou these ninety thousand loads, O Agni, to Indra, to the Bull, to be his portion.
paragraphs.original: एतान्यग्ने नवतिं सहस्रा सं प्र यच्छ वृष्ण इन्द्राय भागम् ।
paragraphs.translit: etānyagne navatiṃ sahasrā saṃ pra yaccha vṛṣṇa indrāya bhāgam |

paragraphs.text: Knowing the paths which Deities duly travel, set mid the Gods in heaven Aulana also.
paragraphs.original: विद्वान्पथ ऋतुशो देवयानानप्यौलानं दिवि देवेषु धेहि
paragraphs.translit: vidvānpatha ṛtuśo devayānānapyaulānaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi

paragraphs.text: 12. O Agni, drive afar our foes, our troubles chase malady away and wicked demons.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने बाधस्व वि मृधो वि दुर्गहापामीवामप रक्षांसि सेध ।
paragraphs.translit: agne bādhasva vi mṛdho vi durgahāpāmīvāmapa rakṣāṃsi sedha |

paragraphs.text: From this air-ocean, from the lofty heavens, send down on us a mighty flood of waters.
paragraphs.original: अस्मात्समुद्राद्बृहतो दिवो नोऽपां भूमानमुप नः सृजेह
paragraphs.translit: asmātsamudrādbṛhato divo no'pāṃ bhūmānamupa naḥ sṛjeha
